review.shows: No link to a sitting member, no FEC number, no age and no offices for "Madeleine Dean Cunnane" (Democratic, district 4).
review.problem: The Clerk of the House lists Madeleine Dean (Bioguide D000631) as the sitting Representative for Pennsylvania's 4th district, Democrat; her campaign site mad4pa.com says the same. The state list prints her married name, so she went unmatched to the roster and to her FEC registration.
